Testimonials.review1Text: The ultimate hunting destination in Malatya. They guided me thoroughly through firearm selection and license paperwork. Extremely courteous and knowledgeable gentlemen.
Testimonials.review2Text: Purchased tactical optics and flashlights here. Tired of grey-market counterfeits, Guner AV sells strictly authentic items with receipts and warranties. A true pleasure to visit.
Testimonials.review3Text: Outdoor apparel and boots selection far surpasses local standards. Found everything I needed under one roof. Full 5 stars well deserved.

About.title: About Guner AV
About.tagline: 30 Years of Trusted Heritage in Malatya
About.subtitle: Serving Malatya's Outdoor & Hunting Community with Integrity for over 30 Years
About.intro: Malatya Av Guner Hunting Dealer was founded to unite a deep passion for the outdoors with uncompromising professionalism and genuine merchant hospitality.
About.storyTitle: Trusted Hunting Dealer: From Tradition to the Future
About.storyP1: Located in Seyh Bayram, Yesilyurt, our showroom has been the primary destination for hunters and outdoor adventurers throughout Malatya and Eastern Anatolia since its foundation.
About.storyP2: For us, hunting is not merely a sport; it is a way of life demanding deep respect for nature, patience, and rigorous safety discipline. Every piece of equipment on our shelves is field-tested and guaranteed by leading international manufacturers.
About.principlesHeading: Trust and Legal Compliance are Our Foundation
About.principle1Desc: All firearm and ammunition transfers are processed in-store with official permits strictly pursuant to Ministry of Interior regulations.
About.principle2Desc: Counterfeit or unauthorized goods will never enter our store. As authorized dealers for top manufacturers, we provide full warranty coverage.
About.principle3Desc: Every guest entering our store is greeted as a fellow outdoor companion. We discuss and choose the right equipment together over tea.
